title: Crochet Flower Belt
name: Flower Belt
seoTitle: Crochet Flower Belt Pattern, Tie Style (Free PDF)
description: Free crochet flower belt pattern: a light dc chain band with five-petal flowers along it and at both tie ends. Easy and printable. Free PDF download.
lead: A pretty tie belt: a light, lacy chain band with five-petal flowers at both ends. Make it as long as you like.
yarn: Cotton yarn in two or more colours

materialsTable.details: Cotton yarn in a band colour and flower colours

rounds.text: Slip knot, ch 5, sl st in the 1st ch.
(ch 2, 2 dc in the ring, ch 2, sl st) x5.
ch 50, then 3 more ch. In the 3rd ch from the hook: 2 dc, ch 2, sl st in the same ch. Repeat to make 5 petals.
ch 5, dc in the 3rd ch from the hook. Repeat (ch 5, dc in the 3rd ch from the hook) to make a long chain.
Join the next colour: (ch 2, 2 dc, ch 2, sl st in the ring) x5 to make 5 petals.
After the last flower: ch 50, (2 dc, ch 2, sl st) in the 3rd ch near the starting loop. Repeat to make 5 petals.

finishing: Tie the belt with the two flower ends.
